setup.label: Setup required
setup.title: Bind the collection inputs before readiness
setup.summary: This fixture shows the qualified inputs that readiness will need. It cannot discover a camera, author scene truth, or create a campaign.

nextAction.title: Prepare the setup artifacts outside this fixture
nextAction.detail: Use an existing qualified profile plus the current human-authored scene and campaign procedures. Continue only when backend artifacts bind the camera, object, condition, and coverage provenance.

setup.authority: Only existing backend and human procedures may establish setup truth. This fixture cannot bind or persist it.

ready.label: Ready to plan
ready.title: The cell is ready for a fresh plan
ready.summary: One qualified camera binding, a known scene revision, and an eligible coverage suggestion are bound to this session. Planning has not started.

nextAction.title: Create a fresh plan in the backend
nextAction.detail: Use the bound condition once. The backend must re-read the current scene and start state before it can show an approval digest.

ready.authority: Readiness is backend-derived. This fixture cannot mark the cell ready or create a plan.

blocked.label: Blocked with next action
blocked.title: Up camera has no fresh frame
blocked.summary: The expected topic exists, but its latest source timestamp is outside the qualified freshness window. Recorder begin and robot goals remain at zero.

nextAction.title: Restore the up-camera stream, then obtain fresh backend readiness
nextAction.detail: Check the bound physical device and topic, restore a fresh source frame, and have the backend re-evaluate current state. Do not change the campaign or reuse an old readiness result.

blocked.authority: Only backend readiness can clear this block after a fresh sample.

approval.label: Exact digest approval
approval.title: Approve only the plan shown here
approval.summary: Path PREGRASP → CLOSE → LIFT is bound to scene revision 14, the current start snapshot, and the selected condition. Campaign approval is not motion approval.
approval.authority: The backend consumes one exact, unexpired human receipt. This fixture only validates the displayed text locally.

running.label: Running progress
running.title: Pickup is in progress
running.summary: The backend reports active collection. Progress is evidence, not a control surface; the physical E-stop remains out of band.

nextAction.title: Observe; use physical E-stop for immediate danger
nextAction.detail: Software cancel is a backend intent and cannot replace the out-of-band safety control.

running.authority: The backend owns recorder, motion, heartbeat, cancel, and scene transitions.

review.label: Semantic review
review.title: Is this a successful pickup demonstration?
review.summary: Technical validation passed. Review the correct object, grasp and lift, trajectory flow, unmodeled contact, and task goal once; semantic PASS still does not grant training approval.

nextAction.title: Make one semantic decision or preserve PENDING
nextAction.detail: FAIL and UNCERTAIN require one primary reason. SKIP leaves the immutable candidate available for later review.

review.authority: Only backend compare-and-swap may transition PENDING once. Dataset training approval is a separate human authority.

recovery.label: Recovery required
recovery.title: Repair the physical scene before replanning
recovery.summary: Release could not be confirmed. The object is UNKNOWN, the destination slot is QUARANTINED, the cell is blocked, and later robot goals are zero.

nextAction.title: Clear the cell, update scene truth, then create a fresh plan
nextAction.detail: Physically locate the object, restore the marked slot, and record a new human scene revision. Never resume or reuse the stale plan.
nextAction.command: repair scene → capture current state → fresh plan → fresh exact approval

recovery.authority: The UI cannot assert physical recovery, scene truth, cell readiness, or permission for a later goal.
